```{r}
library(ADMerge)

BIOCARD_table =get_src_table(path = "/Users/shijia.zhang/Downloads/BIOCARD August 2021 internal",
              ID_usr_list = c("SUBJECT_ID"),

complete_BIOCARD <- review_complete(
  Biocard_merged,
  check_cols = c(
    # -- 基本信息/对齐 --
    "ID_merged",        # 主键（你合并后的一致 ID）
    "Date_timeline",    # 访视日期（或基线日期）
    "VISITNO",          # 访视编号

    # -- 诊断/结局（用于筛 CN 基线 & 推导事件） --
    "DIAGNOSIS",        # 每次访视的临床综合诊断（用来筛 baseline=CN）
    # 若你已有结局衍生列，也可一并检查（没有就删掉下面两行）：

    # -- 人口统计/遗传 --
    "SEX",
    "EDUC",
    "BIRTHYEAR",
    "APOECODE",         # APOE（建议后续衍生 APOE4=1/0）

    # -- 认知（基线） --
    "C1208A",           # DSST（Digit Symbol；论文用之一）
    "C1A109",           # VPA-Immediate（WMS Paired Associates I）

    # -- MRI（基线） --
    "HIPRIGHTV",        # 右海马 ICV 标化体积
    "ECRIGHTT",         # 右内嗅皮层厚度

    # -- CSF（基线） --
    "ptau181",
    "AB42" # p-tau181（Efficient 模型里保留 p-tau）
    # 如果你CSF列名不同(如 PTAU/PTAU_PGML)，把实际列名放这里
  )
)


complete_BIOCARD$complete_df %>% filter(DIAGNOSIS == "NORMAL") %>% distinct(ID_merged)



unique(complete_BIOCARD$complete_df$DIAGNOSIS)



#EDUC #BIRTHYEAR (for age) #C1208A (DSST) #C1A109 (VPA) #APOECODE  #HIPRIGHTV(hippo_right) #ECRIGHTT(entorhinal_R_thick) #AB42 #ptau181
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(survival)
library(timeROC)
library(gtsummary)
```


```{r}
df <- complete_BIOCARD$complete_df

pred_vars <- df %>%
  mutate(
    DSST    = .data$C1208A,       # Digit Symbol
    VPA_IM  = .data$C1A109,       # Paired Associates I
    PTAU    = .data$ptau181,      # CSF p-tau181
    HIPPO_R = .data$HIPRIGHTV,    # 右海马（ICV 标化）
    ERC_R   = .data$ECRIGHTT,     # 右内嗅皮层厚度
    AGE     = lubridate::year(.data$Date_timeline) - .data$BIRTHYEAR,
    AB42 = .data$AB42,

    # —— 关键修改：APOE4 兼容 “3.4 / 34 / E3/E4 / 3-4” 等格式 ——
    APOE4 = case_when(
      is.na(.data$APOECODE) ~ NA_integer_,
      TRUE ~ as.integer(grepl("4",
                gsub("[^0-9]", "", as.character(.data$APOECODE))
              ))
    )
  )



baseline <- pred_vars %>%
  filter(.data$DIAGNOSIS == "NORMAL") %>%
  arrange(.data$ID_merged, .data$Date_timeline) %>%
  group_by(.data$ID_merged) %>%
  slice_head(n = 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  transmute(
    ID_merged,
    baseline_date = .data$Date_timeline,
    AGE, EDUC = .data$EDUC, APOE4,AB42,
    DSST, VPA_IM, HIPPO_R, ERC_R, PTAU
  )


## 2) 用“全时间线”生成事件/删失（用 analysis_data，不限于 complete_df）
diag_long <- Biocard_merged$analysis_data %>%     # 确保有 ID/日期/诊断三列
  select(ID_merged, Date_timeline, DIAGNOSIS)


outcome <- diag_long %>%
  inner_join(baseline %>% select(ID_merged, baseline_date), by = "ID_merged") %>%
  filter(.data$Date_timeline >= .data$baseline_date) %>%
  mutate(is_event = .data$DIAGNOSIS %in% c("MCI", "DEMENTIA")) %>%
  group_by(.data$ID_merged) %>%
  summarise(
    baseline_date = first(.data$baseline_date),
    event_date = if (any(is_event, na.rm = TRUE)) min(.data$Date_timeline[is_event], na.rm = TRUE) else as.Date(NA),
    last_date  = max(.data$Date_timeline, na.rm = TRUE),
    status = as.integer(!is.na(event_date)),  # 1=事件, 0=删失
    T_event = ifelse(status == 1,
                     as.numeric(difftime(event_date, baseline_date, units = "days"))/365.25,
                     as.numeric(difftime(last_date,  baseline_date, units = "days"))/365.25),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


anal <- baseline %>%
  inner_join(outcome, by = c("ID_merged", "baseline_date")) %>%
  filter(T_event > 0)


# 连续变量列表
num_cols <- c("AGE","EDUC","DSST","VPA_IM","HIPPO_R","ERC_R","PTAU","AB42")

# 备份标准化参数（可复现）
sc_mu <- sapply(anal[num_cols], function(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE))
sc_sd <- sapply(anal[num_cols], function(x) sd(x,   na.rm = TRUE))


anal[num_cols] <- lapply(num_cols, function(v) as.numeric(scale(anal[[v]])))

library(survival)

fit_eff <- coxph(Surv(T_event, status) ~ AGE + EDUC + APOE4 +
                   DSST + VPA_IM + HIPPO_R + ERC_R + PTAU + AB42,
                 data = anal)

fit_eff %>% tbl_regression(exponentiate = TRUE)
```
```{r}
library(survivalROC)
lp <- predict(fit_eff, type = "lp")  # 线性预测分数
for (tt in c(5, 7, 10)) {
  r <- survivalROC(Stime = anal$T_event, status = anal$status,
                   marker = lp, predict.time = tt,
                   method = "NNE", span = 0.25)
  cat(tt, "years AUC =", round(r$AUC, 3), "\n")
}

```
```{r}
# 选模型：含 AB42 的 Full（fit_eff）或不含 AB42 的 Efficient（fit_eff2）
fit <- fit_eff        # <- 如需改用 Efficient：fit <- fit_eff2

library(survivalROC)
library(ggplot2)
# 线性预测分数 = Cox 风险分值（marker）
lp <- predict(fit, type = "lp")

# 计算 5/7/10 年 ROC
times <- c(5, 7, 10)
roclist <- lapply(times, function(tt)
  survivalROC(
    Stime        = anal$T_event,
    status       = anal$status,
    marker       = lp,
    predict.time = tt,
    method       = "NNE",
    span         = 0.25
  )
)

# 拼成绘图数据框（带上 AUC 到图例）
rocdf <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(times), function(i) {
  data.frame(
    fpr  = roclist[[i]]$FP,              # 1 - specificity
    tpr  = roclist[[i]]$TP,              # sensitivity
    time = sprintf("%dy (AUC=%.3f)", times[i], roclist[[i]]$AUC)
  )
}))
rocdf <- rocdf[complete.cases(rocdf), ]

# 画图
auc_plot = ggplot(rocdf, aes(x = fpr, y = tpr, color = time)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(
    title = "Time-dependent ROC (Cox risk score)",
    x = "1 - Specificity (FPR)", y = "Sensitivity (TPR)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank())

# 同时在控制台打印各时点 AUC
for (i in seq_along(times)) {
  cat(times[i], "years AUC =", round(roclist[[i]]$AUC, 3), "\n")
}

auc_plot
```

```{r}
# BIOCARD example point 2

library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(survival)

BIOCARD_table =get_src_table(path = "/Users/shijia.zhang/Downloads/BIOCARD August 2021 internal",
              ID_usr_list = c("SUBJECT_ID"),
              DATE_usr_list = c("VISITDATE","DIAGDATE","date","MRIDATE"),
              IS_overlap_list = c("FALSE"),
              WINDOW_list = c(366))


Biocard_merged = ad_merge(path = "/Users/shijia.zhang/Downloads/BIOCARD August 2021 internal",DATE_type = "Date",timeline_file = "BIOCARD_CognitiveData",dict_src = BIOCARD_table)




complete_BIOCARD <- review_complete(
  Biocard_merged,
  check_cols = c(
    # -- 基本信息/对齐 --
    "ID_merged",        # 主键（你合并后的一致 ID）
    "Date_timeline",    # 访视日期（或基线日期）
    "VISITNO",          # 访视编号

    # -- 诊断/结局（用于筛 CN 基线 & 推导事件） --
    "DIAGNOSIS",        # 每次访视的临床综合诊断（用来筛 baseline=CN）
    # 若你已有结局衍生列，也可一并检查（没有就删掉下面两行）：

    # -- 人口统计/遗传 --
    "SEX",
    "EDUC",
    "BIRTHYEAR",
    "APOECODE",         # APOE（建议后续衍生 APOE4=1/0）

    # -- 认知（基线） --
    "C1208A",           # DSST（Digit Symbol；论文用之一）
    "C1A109",           # VPA-Immediate（WMS Paired Associates I）

    # -- MRI（基线） --
    "HIPRIGHTV",        # 右海马 ICV 标化体积
    "ECRIGHTT",         # 右内嗅皮层厚度

    # -- CSF（基线） --
    "ptau181",
    "AB42" # p-tau181（Efficient 模型里保留 p-tau）
    # 如果你CSF列名不同(如 PTAU/PTAU_PGML)，把实际列名放这里
  )
)


df <- complete_BIOCARD$complete_df

df1 <- df %>%
  mutate(
    eTIV = coalesce(EstimatedTotalIntraCranialVol, INTRACVOL),
    WMH_icv = WM_hypointensities / eTIV,
    WMH_log = log1p(WMH_icv),
    AGE = year(Date_timeline) - BIRTHYEAR
  ) %>%
  filter(is.na(Missingness) | Missingness == 0)


# 2) 选“基线”：最早一次 DIAGNOSIS==NORMAL，且 WMH 与 CSF 三项都有（ADMerge 已做 ±366d 窗口）
baseline <- df1 %>%
  filter(DIAGNOSIS == "NORMAL",
         !is.na(WMH_log), !is.na(ttau), !is.na(ptau181), !is.na(AB42)) %>%
  arrange(ID_merged, Date_timeline) %>%
  group_by(ID_merged) %>%
  slice_head(n = 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  transmute(
    ID_merged, baseline_date = Date_timeline,
    SEX, EDUC, AGE,
    WMH_log, ttau, ptau181, AB42
  )


diag_long <- Biocard_merged$analysis_data %>%
  select(ID_merged, Date_timeline, DIAGNOSIS)


outcome <- diag_long %>%
  inner_join(baseline %>% select(ID_merged, baseline_date), by = "ID_merged") %>%
  filter(Date_timeline >= baseline_date) %>%
  mutate(is_event = DIAGNOSIS %in% c("MCI","DEMENTIA")) %>%
  group_by(ID_merged) %>%
  summarise(
    baseline_date = first(baseline_date),
    event_date = if (any(is_event, na.rm=TRUE))
      min(Date_timeline[is_event], na.rm=TRUE) else as.Date(NA),
    last_date = max(Date_timeline, na.rm=TRUE),
    status = as.integer(!is.na(event_date)),
    T_event = ifelse(status==1,
      as.numeric(difftime(event_date, baseline_date, units="days"))/365.25,
      as.numeric(difftime(last_date,  baseline_date, units="days"))/365.25),
    .groups="drop"
  )


anal <- baseline %>%
  inner_join(outcome, by=c("ID_merged","baseline_date")) %>%
  filter(T_event > 0)

# 连续变量 z 分数（论文口径）
zcols <- c("AGE","EDUC","WMH_log","ttau","ptau181","AB42")
for (v in zcols) anal[[paste0(v,"_z")]] <- as.numeric(scale(anal[[v]]))

# 1) 交互模型
fit_int <- coxph(Surv(T_event, status) ~ AGE_z + SEX + EDUC_z +
                   WMH_log_z*ttau_z + ptau181_z + AB42_z,
                 data = anal)
summary(fit_int)



# 2) simple slopes：在低/高 t-tau 评估 WMH 效应（用 tertiles 更贴论文）
tt_cut <- quantile(anal$ttau, probs = c(1/3, 2/3), na.rm = TRUE)
anal <- anal %>%
  mutate(
    ttau_grp = cut(ttau, breaks = c(-Inf, tt_cut, Inf),
                   labels = c("Low","Mid","High"), include.lowest = TRUE)
  )

# 只用 Low / High 两组分别看 WMH 的 HR
fit_low  <- coxph(Surv(T_event, status) ~ AGE_z + SEX + EDUC_z +
                    WMH_log_z + ptau181_z + AB42_z,
                  data = subset(anal, ttau_grp=="Low"))
fit_high <- coxph(Surv(T_event, status) ~ AGE_z + SEX + EDUC_z +
                    WMH_log_z + ptau181_z + AB42_z,
                  data = subset(anal, ttau_grp=="High"))

exp(cbind(HR_low  = coef(fit_low )["WMH_log_z"],
          HR_high = coef(fit_high)["WMH_log_z"]))
confint(fit_low )["WMH_log_z",]
confint(fit_high)["WMH_log_z",]
```


```{r}
library(ggplot2)


anal <- anal %>%
  mutate(
    SEX = factor(SEX, levels = c(1, 2), labels = c("M", "F"))
  )

# 构造不同 t-tau 下的预测数据
wmh_seq <- seq(-2, 2, length.out = 100)
make_pred <- function(ttau_level) {
  data.frame(
    AGE_z = 0,
    SEX = factor("F", levels = levels(anal$SEX)), # 如果你的SEX变量不是F/M请修改
    EDUC_z = 0,
    WMH_log_z = wmh_seq,
    ttau_z = rep(ttau_level, length(wmh_seq)),
    ptau181_z = 0,
    AB42_z = 0,
    tgroup = ifelse(ttau_level < 0, "Low t-tau", "High t-tau")
  )
}

pred_low  <- make_pred(-1)
pred_high <- make_pred(1)
pred_plot <- rbind(pred_low, pred_high)
pred_plot$risk <- predict(fit_int, newdata = pred_plot, type = "lp")



p_int <- ggplot(pred_plot, aes(x = WMH_log_z, y = risk, color = tgroup)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  labs(
    title = "WMH × t-tau Interaction (Soldan et al.)",
    x = "WMH (z-score)",
    y = "Log Relative Risk"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank()) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("High t-tau" = "#EF476F", "Low t-tau" = "#06D6A0"))

print(p_int)


# 提取主效应HR及置信区间
HR_low  <- exp(coef(fit_low)["WMH_log_z"])
HR_high <- exp(coef(fit_high)["WMH_log_z"])
CI_low  <- exp(confint(fit_low)["WMH_log_z",])
CI_high <- exp(confint(fit_high)["WMH_log_z",])

forest_dat <- data.frame(
  Group = c("Low t-tau", "High t-tau"),
  HR = c(HR_low, HR_high),
  LCL = c(CI_low[1], CI_high[1]),
  UCL = c(CI_low[2], CI_high[2])
)

p_forest <- ggplot(forest_dat, aes(x = Group, y = HR, ymin = LCL, ymax = UCL)) +
  geom_pointrange(size = 1.1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Hazard Ratio of WMH by t-tau Group",
       y = "Hazard Ratio (95% CI)", x = "") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)

print(p_forest)


library(patchwork)
final_plot <- auc_plot + p_int + plot_layout(ncol = 2) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Replication of Multi-modal Prognostic Models in BIOCARD",
    subtitle = "Left: Time-dependent AUC (Albert et al.). Right: WMH × t-tau Interaction (Soldan et al.)",
    caption = "Data processed and merged via ADMerge R package."
  )
print(final_plot)
```

```{r}
library(lme4)
library(broom.mixed)

# 1) 构建 MRI 纵向：按“各自第一次 MRI”定零点，年为单位
mri_long <- df1 %>%
  filter(!is.na(WMH_log)) %>%
  group_by(ID_merged) %>%
  mutate(t0_mri = min(Date_timeline, na.rm = TRUE),
         t_years = as.numeric(difftime(Date_timeline, t0_mri, units="days"))/365.25,
         AGE0 = first(year(t0_mri) - BIRTHYEAR),
         SEX0 = first(SEX)) %>%
  ungroup()

# 2) CSF 纵向：同样按“各自第一次 CSF”定零点（或同 MRI 零点，一致性更强）
csf_long <- df %>%
  filter(!is.na(ttau)) %>%
  group_by(ID_merged) %>%
  mutate(t0_csf = min(Date_timeline, na.rm = TRUE),
         t_years = as.numeric(difftime(Date_timeline, t0_csf, units="days"))/365.25,
         AGE0 = first(year(t0_csf) - BIRTHYEAR),
         SEX0 = first(SEX)) %>%
  ungroup()

# 3) 各自随机斜率（≥2 次观测的被试才有斜率）
mri_long2 <- mri_long %>% group_by(ID_merged) %>% filter(n() >= 2) %>% ungroup()
csf_long2 <- csf_long %>% group_by(ID_merged) %>% filter(n() >= 2) %>% ungroup()

fit_wmh_lmm  <- lmer(WMH_log ~ t_years + AGE0 + SEX0 + (t_years | ID_merged), data = mri_long2)
fit_ttau_lmm <- lmer(scale(ttau) ~ t_years + AGE0 + SEX0 + (t_years | ID_merged), data = csf_long2)

sl_wmh  <- ranef(fit_wmh_lmm)$ID_merged[,"t_years", drop=TRUE]
sl_ttau <- ranef(fit_ttau_lmm)$ID_merged[,"t_years", drop=TRUE]

slopes <- tibble(
  ID_merged = rownames(ranef(fit_wmh_lmm)$ID_merged),
  slope_WMH = as.numeric(sl_wmh)
) %>%
  inner_join(tibble(
    ID_merged = rownames(ranef(fit_ttau_lmm)$ID_merged),
    slope_ttau = as.numeric(sl_ttau)
  ), by = "ID_merged")

# 4) 相关 + 回归（可加稳健法/去极端值）
cor.test(slopes$slope_WMH, slopes$slope_ttau)
summary(lm(slope_WMH ~ slope_ttau, data = slopes))
```

```{r}
fit_int: coxph(Surv(T_event,status) ~ AGE_z + SEX + EDUC_z +
               WMH_log_z*ttau_z + ptau181_z + AB42_z, data=anal)

b <- coef(fit_int)
V <- vcov(fit_int)

beta_W  <- b["WMH_log_z"]
beta_I  <- b["WMH_log_z:ttau_z"]

var_W   <- V["WMH_log_z","WMH_log_z"]
var_I   <- V["WMH_log_z:ttau_z","WMH_log_z:ttau_z"]
cov_WI  <- V["WMH_log_z","WMH_log_z:ttau_z"]

simple_slope <- function(t0) {
  est <- beta_W + t0*beta_I                    # log(HR) of WMH at ttau_z = t0
  se  <- sqrt(var_W + t0^2*var_I + 2*t0*cov_WI)
  HR  <- exp(est); LCL <- exp(est - 1.96*se); UCL <- exp(est + 1.96*se)
  p   <- 2*pnorm(-abs(est/se))
  data.frame(ttau_z=t0, HR=HR, LCL=LCL, UCL=UCL, p=p)
}

# 看几个代表性水平：均值±1SD、以及 t-tau 的三分位数中心
tt_vals <- c(-1, 0, 1,
             scale(quantile(anal$ttau, probs=c(1/3,2/3), na.rm=TRUE))[,1])
do.call(rbind, lapply(tt_vals, simple_slope))
```

```{r}
  filter(DIAGNOSIS == "NORMAL", !is.na(WMH_log), !is.na(ttau), !is.na(ptau181), !is.na(AB42)) %>%
  arrange(ID_merged, Date_timeline) %>%
  group_by(ID_merged) %>%
  slice_head(n = 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  transmute(
    ID_merged, baseline_date = Date_timeline,
    SEX, EDUC, AGE, WMH_log, ttau, ptau181, AB42
  )

diag_long <- Biocard_merged$analysis_data %>%
  select(ID_merged, Date_timeline, DIAGNOSIS)

outcome <- diag_long %>%
  inner_join(baseline %>% select(ID_merged, baseline_date), by = "ID_merged") %>%
  filter(Date_timeline >= baseline_date) %>%
  mutate(is_event = DIAGNOSIS %in% c("MCI", "DEMENTIA")) %>%
  group_by(ID_merged) %>%
  summarise(
    baseline_date = first(baseline_date),
    event_date = if (any(is_event, na.rm=TRUE)) min(Date_timeline[is_event], na.rm=TRUE) else as.Date(NA),
    last_date = max(Date_timeline, na.rm=TRUE),
    status = as.integer(!is.na(event_date)),
    T_event = ifelse(status==1,
      as.numeric(difftime(event_date, baseline_date, units="days"))/365.25,
      as.numeric(difftime(last_date,  baseline_date, units="days"))/365.25),
    .groups="drop"
  )

anal <- baseline %>%
  inner_join(outcome, by = c("ID_merged", "baseline_date")) %>%
  filter(T_event > 0)

```


```{r}
# 连续变量标准化
zcols <- c("AGE","EDUC","WMH_log","ttau","ptau181","AB42")
for (v in zcols) anal[[paste0(v,"_z")]] <- as.numeric(scale(anal[[v]]))

# Cox全模型
fit_eff <- coxph(Surv(T_event, status) ~ AGE_z + SEX + EDUC_z + WMH_log_z + ttau_z + ptau181_z + AB42_z, data = anal)

# 计算预测分数
lp <- predict(fit_eff, type = "lp")
times <- c(5, 7, 10)
roclist <- lapply(times, function(tt)
  survivalROC(
    Stime = anal$T_event,
    status = anal$status,
    marker = lp,
    predict.time = tt,
    method = "NNE",
    span = 0.25
  )
)
rocdf <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(times), function(i) {
  data.frame(
    fpr  = roclist[[i]]$FP,
    tpr  = roclist[[i]]$TP,
    time = sprintf("%dy (AUC=%.3f)", times[i], roclist[[i]]$AUC)
  )
}))
rocdf <- rocdf[complete.cases(rocdf), ]

p_auc <- ggplot(rocdf, aes(x = fpr, y = tpr, color = time)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.1) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(
    title = "A) Time-dependent ROC (Albert et al.)",
    x = "1 - Specificity (FPR)", y = "Sensitivity (TPR)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank())

```

```{r}
# 交互模型
fit_int <- coxph(Surv(T_event, status) ~ AGE_z + SEX + EDUC_z + WMH_log_z*ttau_z + ptau181_z + AB42_z, data = anal)

# 加载包
library(dplyr)
library(survival)
library(ggplot2)

# fit_int 已拟合好
# fit_int <- coxph(Surv(T_event, status) ~ AGE_z + SEX + EDUC_z + WMH_log_z*ttau_z + ptau181_z + AB42_z, data = anal)

# 强制把 SEX 变为因子
anal <- anal %>%
  mutate(SEX = factor(SEX))

# t-tau 分三组
tt_cut <- quantile(anal$ttau, probs = c(1/3, 2/3), na.rm = TRUE)
anal <- anal %>%
  mutate(
    ttau_grp = cut(
      ttau,
      breaks = c(-Inf, tt_cut, Inf),
      labels = c("Low", "Mid", "High"),
      include.lowest = TRUE
    )
  )

# 画交互作图数据
wmh_seq <- seq(-2, 2, length.out = 100)
make_pred <- function(ttau_level) {
  data.frame(
    AGE_z = 0,
    SEX = factor("2", levels = c("1", "2")),   # 女（2）是预测用的，但必须给全 levels
    EDUC_z = 0,
    WMH_log_z = wmh_seq,
    ttau_z = rep(ttau_level, length(wmh_seq)),
    ptau181_z = 0,
    AB42_z = 0
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      risk = predict(fit_int, newdata = ., type = "lp"),
      ttau_level = factor(ttau_level)
    )
}
# 用 t-tau z-score -1, +1 作为 low/high
pred_low <- make_pred(-1)
pred_high <- make_pred(1)

pred_plot <- bind_rows(
  transform(pred_low, tgroup = "Low t-tau"),
  transform(pred_high, tgroup = "High t-tau")
)

# 作图
p_int <- ggplot(pred_plot, aes(x = WMH_log_z, y = risk, color = tgroup)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.1) +
  labs(
    title = "WMH × t-tau Interaction (Soldan et al.)",
    x = "WMH (z-score)",
    y = "Log Relative Risk"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank())




```


```{r}
library(patchwork)
final_plot <- p_auc + p_int + plot_layout(ncol = 2) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Replication of Multi-modal Prognostic Models in BIOCARD",
    subtitle = "Left: Time-dependent AUC (Albert et al.). Right: WMH × t-tau Interaction (Soldan et al.)",
    caption = "Data processed and merged via ADMerge R package."
  )
print(final_plot)
```

ADNI M1

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(stringr)
library(lmerTest)

## ——— 0) 只用一条 CSF 时间轴（假定你已 ad_merge 到 adni_merged_csf） ———
## adni_merged_csf <- ad_merge(path="ADNI_demonstration", DATE_type="Date",
##                             timeline_file="CSF_xxx", dict_src=ADNI_table)

## ——— 1) 基线完整性：CSF 两个指标 + 协变量 都要齐（确保严格可比 & 反向模型可对称） ———
complete_ADNI_csf <- review_complete(
  adni_merged_csf,
  check_cols = c("ID_merged","Date_timeline",
                 # CSF
                 "AB42_F","pT217_F",
                 # 协变量
                 "PTDOBYY","PTGENDER","PTEDUCAT","GENOTYPE","DIAGNOSIS")
)

bl_csf <- complete_ADNI_csf$complete_df %>%
  mutate(Date_timeline = as.Date(Date_timeline)) %>%
  arrange(ID_merged, Date_timeline) %>%
  distinct(ID_merged, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%     # 每人第一条“全齐”的 CSF 记录
  transmute(
    ID_merged,
    bl_date    = Date_timeline,
    Abeta42_bl = AB42_F,
    pTau_bl    = pT217_F,
    Sex_bl     = PTGENDER,
    Edu_bl     = PTEDUCAT,
    APOE4_bl   = GENOTYPE,
    PTDOBYY_bl = PTDOBYY,
    Dx_bl_raw  = DIAGNOSIS
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Sex_bl = factor(case_when(Sex_bl == 1 ~ "M",
                              Sex_bl == 2 ~ "F",
                              TRUE ~ NA_character_), levels = c("M","F")),
    Dx_bl  = factor(case_when(Dx_bl_raw == 1 ~ "CN",
                              Dx_bl_raw == 2 ~ "MCI",
                              Dx_bl_raw == 3 ~ "AD",
                              TRUE ~ NA_character_), levels = c("CN","MCI","AD")),
    APOE4_carrier = if_else(str_detect(APOE4_bl, "4"), 1L, 0L),
    Age_bl  = year(bl_date) - PTDOBYY_bl,

    ## 基线变换/标准化（两边模型都要）
    pTau_bl_log   = ifelse(pTau_bl > 0, log(pTau_bl), NA_real_),
    Abeta42_bl_log= ifelse(Abeta42_bl > 0, log(Abeta42_bl), NA_real_),

    Abeta42_bl_c  = as.numeric(scale(Abeta42_bl, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)),
    pTau_bl_log_c = as.numeric(scale(pTau_bl_log,  center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)),
    Age_bl_c      = as.numeric(scale(Age_bl,       center = TRUE, scale = TRUE))
  ) %>%
  select(ID_merged, bl_date,
         Abeta42_bl, Abeta42_bl_log, Abeta42_bl_c,
         pTau_bl, pTau_bl_log, pTau_bl_log_c,
         Age_bl_c, Sex_bl, Edu_bl, APOE4_carrier, Dx_bl)

## ——— 2) 纵向长表：同一时间轴灌入两条 CSF 结局（AB42_F & pT217_F） ———
csf_long <- bl_csf %>%
  left_join(
    adni_merged_csf$analysis_data %>%
      transmute(ID_merged,
                Date_timeline = as.Date(Date_timeline),
                AB42_F, pT217_F),
    by = "ID_merged"
  ) %>%
  filter(Date_timeline >= bl_date) %>%    # 去掉基线前，避免负时间
  mutate(
    Time_year  = as.numeric(difftime(Date_timeline, bl_date, units = "days"))/365.25,
    pTau_log   = ifelse(pT217_F > 0,  log(pT217_F),  NA_real_),
    Abeta_log  = ifelse(AB42_F  > 0,  log(AB42_F),   NA_real_)
  )

## ——— 3A) 正向：pTau_217 随时间变化，受 baseline Abeta42 影响（主效应 + Time 交互） ———
dat_ptau <- csf_long %>%
  group_by(ID_merged) %>%
  filter(sum(!is.na(pT217_F)) >= 2, any(Time_year > 0 & !is.na(pT217_F))) %>% # ≥2 次 & 至少一次随访
  ungroup()

m_pTau_from_Abeta <- lmer(
  pTau_log ~ Time_year +
    Abeta42_bl_c  + Time_year:Abeta42_bl_c +
    Age_bl_c + Sex_bl + Edu_bl + factor(APOE4_carrier) + Dx_bl +
    (1 + Time_year | ID_merged),
  data = dat_ptau
)
summary(m_pTau_from_Abeta)

## ——— 3B) 反向（你要的 reverse）：Abeta42 随时间变化，受 baseline pTau_217 影响 ———
dat_abeta <- csf_long %>%
  group_by(ID_merged) %>%
  filter(sum(!is.na(AB42_F)) >= 2, any(Time_year > 0 & !is.na(AB42_F))) %>%
  ungroup()

m_Abeta_from_pTau <- lmer(
  Abeta_log ~ Time_year +
    pTau_bl_log_c + Time_year:pTau_bl_log_c +
    Age_bl_c + Sex_bl + Edu_bl + factor(APOE4_carrier) + Dx_bl +
    (1 + Time_year | ID_merged),
  data = dat_abeta
)
summary(m_Abeta_from_pTau)

## ——— 4) 小提示（可选）——若出现 singular fit，可退一步用随机截距： ———
# m_Abeta_from_pTau_ri <- lmer(
#   Abeta_log ~ Time_year +
#     pTau_bl_log_c + Time_year:pTau_bl_log_c +
#     Age_bl_c + Sex_bl + Edu_bl + factor(APOE4_carrier) + Dx_bl +
#     (1 | ID_merged),
#   data = dat_abeta
# )
# summary(m_Abeta_from_pTau_ri)


```

```{r}
adni_merged_mri = ad_merge(path = "ADNI_demonstration",DATE_type = "Date",timeline_file = "UCSFFSX7",dict_src = ADNI_table)


# complete_ADNI_all <- review_complete(
#   adni_merged_mri,
#   check_cols <- c(
#   # MRI
#   "ST29SV","ST88SV","ST24TA","ST83TA","ST10CV",

#   # CSF
#   "AB42_F","pT217_F",

#   "PTDOBYY","PTGENDER","PTEDUCAT","GENOTYPE","DIAGNOSIS"
# ))


## 1) MRI 版 review_complete：检查你关心的 MRI + 协变量列是否完整
complete_ADNI_mri <- review_complete(
  adni_merged_mri,
  check_cols <- c(
  # CSF
  "AB42_F","pT217_F",
  # 协变量
  "PTDOBYY","PTGENDER","PTEDUCAT","GENOTYPE","DIAGNOSIS"
))

## 2) 取“每人最早一次 MRI 作为 MRI 基线”
bl_mri <- complete_ADNI_mri$complete_df %>%
  mutate(Date_timeline = as.Date(Date_timeline),
         ID_merged = as.character(ID_merged)) %>%
  arrange(ID_merged, Date_timeline) %>%
  distinct(ID_merged, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  transmute(
    ID_merged,
    mri_bl_date = Date_timeline,
    Hipp_bl     = (ST29SV + ST88SV)/2,
    EC_bl       = (ST24TA + ST83TA)/2,
    ICV_bl      = ST10CV,
    Sex_bl_mri  = PTGENDER,
    Edu_bl_mri  = PTEDUCAT,
    Dx_bl_mri   = DIAGNOSIS,
    PTDOBYY_bl  = PTDOBYY,
    APOE_bl     = GENOTYPE
  )

## 3) 把 ID 类型对齐；只保留 “同时有 CSF 基线（bl）和 MRI 基线（bl_mri）的人”
bl_csfin <- bl %>% mutate(ID_merged = as.character(ID_merged))
ids_both <- intersect(bl_csfin$ID_merged, bl_mri$ID_merged)

## 4) 组装 MRI 纵向长表（只留两边都有的人），并贴回 CSF 基线协变量
library(dplyr); library(lubridate); library(stringr)

dat_mri <- adni_merged_mri$analysis_data %>%
  mutate(ID_merged = as.character(ID_merged),
         Date_timeline = as.Date(Date_timeline)) %>%
  semi_join(tibble(ID_merged = ids_both), by = "ID_merged") %>%
  select(ID_merged, Date_timeline, ST29SV, ST88SV, ST24TA, ST83TA, ST10CV) %>%
  left_join(bl_mri, by = "ID_merged") %>%
  mutate(
    Time_year = as.numeric(difftime(Date_timeline, mri_bl_date, units = "days"))/365.25,
    Hipp      = (ST29SV + ST88SV)/2,
    ECthick   = (ST24TA + ST83TA)/2,
    ICV       = ST10CV,
    Age_mri_bl   = year(mri_bl_date) - PTDOBYY_bl
  ) %>%
  ## 贴回你“CSF 基线”的 Aβ42 / p-tau（做交互要用）
  left_join(
    bl_csfin %>%
      transmute(
        ID_merged,
        Abeta42_bl_c = as.numeric(scale(Abeta42_bl, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)),
        pTau_bl_log_c = {
          x <- ifelse(pTau_bl > 0, log(pTau_bl), NA_real_)
          as.numeric(scale(x, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE))
        },
        Sex_bl = factor(case_when(Sex_bl == 1 ~ "M",
                                  Sex_bl == 2 ~ "F",
                                  TRUE ~ NA_character_), levels = c("M","F")),
        Dx_bl  = factor(case_when(Dx_bl == 1 ~ "CN",
                                  Dx_bl == 2 ~ "MCI",
                                  Dx_bl == 3 ~ "AD",
                                  TRUE ~ NA_character_), levels = c("CN","MCI","AD")),
        Edu_bl,
        APOE4_carrier = as.integer(str_detect(APOE4_bl, "4"))
      ),
    by = "ID_merged"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Age_mri_bl_c = as.numeric(scale(Age_mri_bl, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)),
    ICV_c        = as.numeric(scale(ICV,       center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)),
    Hipp_z       = as.numeric(scale(Hipp,      center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)),
    ECthick_z    = as.numeric(scale(ECthick,   center = TRUE, scale = TRUE))
  ) %>%
  group_by(ID_merged) %>%
  filter(sum(!is.na(Hipp)) >= 2 | sum(!is.na(ECthick)) >= 2) %>%  # 至少两次 MRI
  ungroup()

## 5) 快速检查是否还有整列 NA
colSums(is.na(dat_mri[, c("Abeta42_bl_c","pTau_bl_log_c","Sex_bl","Dx_bl",
                          "Edu_bl","APOE4_carrier","Age_mri_bl","ICV_c","Hipp_z","ECthick_z")] ))


m2 <- lmer(
  Hipp_z ~ Time_year +
    Abeta42_bl_c + Time_year:Abeta42_bl_c +
    pTau_bl_log_c + Time_year:pTau_bl_log_c +
    Age_mri_bl_c + Sex_bl + Edu_bl + factor(APOE4_carrier) + Dx_bl +
    ICV_c +
    (1 + Time_year | ID_merged),
  data = dat_mri %>% filter(!is.na(Hipp_z))
)


summary(m2)

m3 <- lmer(
  ECthick_z ~ Time_year +
    Abeta42_bl_c + Time_year:Abeta42_bl_c +
    pTau_bl_log_c + Time_year:pTau_bl_log_c +
    Age_mri_bl_c + Sex_bl + Edu_bl + factor(APOE4_carrier) + Dx_bl +
    ICV_c +
    (1 + Time_year | ID_merged),
  data = dat_mri %>% filter(!is.na(ECthick_z))
)

summary(m3)
```

```{r}
dat_ptau <- adni_merged_csf$analysis_data %>%

  filter(
    sum(!is.na(pT217_F)) >= 2,
    any(Time_year > 0 & !is.na(pT217_F))
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  left_join(bl_rev, by = "ID_merged")


mT_main <- lmer(
  pTau_log ~ Time_year +
    Hipp_bl_c + Time_year:Hipp_bl_c +
    EC_bl_c   + Time_year:EC_bl_c +
    Abeta42_bl_c + Time_year:Abeta42_bl_c +
    Age_bl_c + Sex_bl + Edu_bl + factor(APOE4_carrier) + Dx_bl + ICV_bl_c +
    (1 + Time_year | ID_merged),
  data = dat_ptau
)

summary(mT_main)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(stringr)
library(lmerTest)

## 0) 用 CSF 时间轴合并一次，把 MRI 列也放进 completeness 里
complete_ADNI_csf_mri <- review_complete(
  adni_merged_csf,
  check_cols = c(

    "PTDOBYY","PTGENDER","PTEDUCAT","GENOTYPE","DIAGNOSIS",

    "ST29SV","ST88SV",    # 左/右海马体积
    "ST24TA","ST83TA",    # 左/右内嗅厚度
    "ST10CV"              # ICV
  )
)

## 1) 基线表（每人最早一次、含所有需要的基线协变量）
bl_rev <- complete_ADNI_csf_mri$complete_df %>%
  mutate(Date_timeline = as.Date(Date_timeline)) %>%
  arrange(ID_merged, Date_timeline) %>%
  distinct(ID_merged, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  transmute(
    ID_merged,
    bl_date = Date_timeline,
    # CSF 基线
    Abeta42_bl = AB42_F,
    pTau_bl    = pT217_F,
    # MRI 基线
    Hipp_bl = (ST29SV + ST88SV)/2,
    EC_bl   = (ST24TA + ST83TA)/2,
    ICV_bl  = ST10CV,
    # 人口学/诊断
    Sex_bl     = PTGENDER,
    Edu_bl     = PTEDUCAT,
    APOE4_bl   = GENOTYPE,
    PTDOBYY_bl = PTDOBYY,
    Dx_bl      = DIAGNOSIS
  ) %>%
  # 编码与派生
  mutate(
    Sex_bl = factor(case_when(Sex_bl == 1 ~ "M",
                              Sex_bl == 2 ~ "F",
                              TRUE ~ NA_character_), levels = c("M","F")),
    Dx_bl  = factor(case_when(Dx_bl == 1 ~ "CN",
                              Dx_bl == 2 ~ "MCI",
                              Dx_bl == 3 ~ "AD",
                              TRUE ~ NA_character_), levels = c("CN","MCI","AD")),
    APOE4_carrier = as.integer(str_detect(as.character(APOE4_bl), "4")),
    Age_bl  = year(bl_date) - PTDOBYY_bl,
    # 变换与中心化
    Abeta42_bl_c  = as.numeric(scale(Abeta42_bl, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)),
    pTau_bl_log   = ifelse(pTau_bl > 0, log(pTau_bl), NA_real_),
    pTau_bl_log_c = as.numeric(scale(pTau_bl_log, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)),
    Hipp_bl_c     = as.numeric(scale(Hipp_bl,  center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)),
    EC_bl_c       = as.numeric(scale(EC_bl,    center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)),
    ICV_bl_c      = as.numeric(scale(ICV_bl,   center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)),
    Age_bl_c      = as.numeric(scale(Age_bl,   center = TRUE, scale = TRUE))
  )

## 2) p-tau 纵向长表（贴回基线协变量）
dat_tau <- bl_rev %>%
  left_join(
    adni_merged_csf$analysis_data %>%
      select(ID_merged, Date_timeline, pT217_F),
    by = "ID_merged"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Date_timeline = as.Date(Date_timeline),
    Time_year = as.numeric(difftime(Date_timeline, bl_date, units = "days"))/365.25,
    pTau_log  = ifelse(pT217_F > 0, log(pT217_F), NA_real_)
  ) %>%
  group_by(ID_merged) %>%
  filter(
    sum(!is.na(pT217_F)) >= 2,
    any(Time_year > 0 & !is.na(pT217_F))
  ) %>%
  arrange(ID_merged, Time_year) %>%
  ungroup()

## 3) 反向模型：MRI/Abeta 基线预测 p-tau 的纵向变化
mR_pTau <- lmer(
  pTau_log ~ Time_year +
    Abeta42_bl_c + Time_year:Abeta42_bl_c +
    Hipp_bl_c    + Time_year:Hipp_bl_c +
    EC_bl_c      + Time_year:EC_bl_c +
    Age_bl_c + Sex_bl + Edu_bl + factor(APOE4_carrier) + Dx_bl + ICV_bl_c +
    (1 + Time_year | ID_merged),
  data = dat_tau
)

summary(mR_pTau)
```

```{r}
    Abeta42_bl = AB42_F,
    # demo/genetics/diag

  ) %>%
  mutate(

                              Sex_bl == 2 ~ "F",

                              Dx_bl_raw == 2 ~ "MCI",

    APOE4_carrier = if_else(str_detect(APOE4_bl, "4"), 1L, 0L),

    pTau_bl_log   = ifelse(pTau_bl > 0, log(pTau_bl), NA_real_),
    Abeta42_bl_c  = as.numeric(scale(Abeta42_bl, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)),

    Hipp_bl_c     = as.numeric(scale(Hipp_bl,      center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)),
    EC_bl_c       = as.numeric(scale(EC_bl,        center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)),
    ICV_bl_c      = as.numeric(scale(ICV_bl,       center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)),
```

```{r}
                "Abeta42_bl_c","ICV_bl_c","Age_bl_c",
                "Sex_bl","Edu_bl","APOE4_carrier","Dx_bl") %in% names(dat_lm)))

## 4) M5-LM：与 ADAS 口径一致 —— Time × (Hipp/EC, pTau, Abeta) + 协变量
```

```{r}

# 用这个
## ===== 必要包 =====
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(lubridate)
  library(stringr)
  library(lmerTest)
})

## ===== 仅一条时间轴（MRI 合并表）=====
adni_merged_mri <- ad_merge(
  path = "ADNI_demonstration",
  DATE_type = "Date",
  timeline_file = "UCSFFSX7",
  dict_src = ADNI_table
)

## ===== 用 review_complete：MRI + 协变量 + 认知 + CSF 都要齐（单次“基线行”）=====
check_cols <- c(
  # CSF
  "AB42_F","pT217_F",
  "TOTSCORE","LIMMTOTAL",
  # 协变量
  "PTDOBYY","PTGENDER","PTEDUCAT","GENOTYPE","DIAGNOSIS")


complete_ADNI_mri <- review_complete(adni_merged_mri, check_cols = check_cols)

## ===== 1) 单一“基线表”：每人第一条所有 check_cols 都齐的记录 =====
bl_all <- complete_ADNI_mri$complete_df %>%
  mutate(
    ID_merged     = as.character(ID_merged),
    Date_timeline = as.Date(Date_timeline)
  ) %>%
  filter(if_all(all_of(check_cols), ~ !is.na(.))) %>%
  arrange(ID_merged, Date_timeline) %>%
  group_by(ID_merged) %>%
  slice_head(n = 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  transmute(
    ID_merged,
    mri_bl_date = Date_timeline,

    ## MRI 基线派生（控制起点用）
    Hipp_bl   = (ST29SV + ST88SV)/2,
    EC_bl     = (ST24TA + ST83TA)/2,
    ICV_bl    = ST10CV,
    Hipp_bl_c = as.numeric(scale(Hipp_bl, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)),
    EC_bl_c   = as.numeric(scale(EC_bl,   center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)),

    ## 认知基线（输入）
    ADAS_bl   = TOTSCORE,
    LM_bl     = LIMMTOTAL,
    ADAS_bl_c = as.numeric(scale(TOTSCORE,  center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)),
    LM_bl_c   = as.numeric(scale(LIMMTOTAL, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)),

    ## CSF 基线（输入）
    Abeta42_bl    = AB42_F,
    pTau_bl       = pT217_F,
    Abeta42_bl_c  = as.numeric(scale(Abeta42_bl, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)),
    pTau_bl_log_c = {
      x <- ifelse(pTau_bl > 0, log(pTau_bl), NA_real_)
      as.numeric(scale(x, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE))
    },

    ## 协变量（基线）
    PTDOBYY_bl  = PTDOBYY,
    PTGENDER_bl = PTGENDER,
    PTEDUCAT_bl = PTEDUCAT,
    GENOTYPE_bl = GENOTYPE,
    DIAGNOSIS_bl= DIAGNOSIS,
    Age_mri_bl   = year(mri_bl_date) - PTDOBYY,
    Age_mri_bl_c = as.numeric(scale(Age_mri_bl, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)),
    Sex_bl = factor(case_when(PTGENDER == 1 ~ "M",
                              PTGENDER == 2 ~ "F",
                              TRUE ~ NA_character_), levels = c("M","F")),
    Dx_bl  = factor(case_when(DIAGNOSIS == 1 ~ "CN",
                              DIAGNOSIS == 2 ~ "MCI",
                              DIAGNOSIS == 3 ~ "AD",
                              TRUE ~ NA_character_), levels = c("CN","MCI","AD")),
    Edu_bl        = PTEDUCAT,
    APOE4_carrier = as.integer(str_detect(as.character(GENOTYPE), "4"))
  )

## ===== 2) MRI 纵向长表：基线广播 + 去负时间 + 去重 + ≥2 次 MRI =====
mri_long <- adni_merged_mri$analysis_data %>%
  mutate(
    ID_merged     = as.character(ID_merged),
    Date_timeline = as.Date(Date_timeline)
  ) %>%
  semi_join(bl_all %>% select(ID_merged), by = "ID_merged") %>%
  select(ID_merged, Date_timeline, ST29SV, ST88SV, ST24TA, ST83TA, ST10CV) %>%
  distinct(ID_merged, Date_timeline, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  left_join(bl_all, by = "ID_merged") %>%
  filter(Date_timeline >= mri_bl_date) %>%  # 基线及之后 → Time >= 0
  mutate(
    Time_year = as.numeric(difftime(Date_timeline, mri_bl_date, units = "days"))/365.25,
    Hipp      = (ST29SV + ST88SV)/2,
    ECthick   = (ST24TA + ST83TA)/2,
    ICV       = ST10CV,
    ICV_c     = as.numeric(scale(ICV,     center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)),
    Hipp_z    = as.numeric(scale(Hipp,    center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)),
    ECthick_z = as.numeric(scale(ECthick, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE))
  ) %>%
  group_by(ID_merged) %>%
  filter(sum(!is.na(Hipp)) >= 2 | sum(!is.na(ECthick)) >= 2) %>%  # 至少两次 MRI
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(ID_merged, Time_year)

## ===== 3) 建模（MRI 为输出，CSF + 认知为输入）=====
## 模型 A：Hipp_z ~ Time + (CSF, COG 主效应 + 与 Time 的交互) + 协变量 + MRI基线 + ICV
m_Hipp <- lmer(
  Hipp_z ~ Time_year +
    Abeta42_bl_c  + Time_year:Abeta42_bl_c +
    pTau_bl_log_c + Time_year:pTau_bl_log_c +
    ADAS_bl_c     + Time_year:ADAS_bl_c +
    LM_bl_c       + Time_year:LM_bl_c +                                     # 控制 MRI 起点
    Age_mri_bl_c + Sex_bl + Edu_bl + factor(APOE4_carrier) + Dx_bl +
    ICV_c +
    (1 + Time_year | ID_merged),
  data = mri_long %>% filter(!is.na(Hipp_z))
)
summary(m_Hipp)

## 模型 B：ECthick_z ~ 同上（用 EC_bl_c 控制 MRI 起点）
m_EC <- lmer(
  ECthick_z ~ Time_year +
    Abeta42_bl_c  + Time_year:Abeta42_bl_c +
    pTau_bl_log_c + Time_year:pTau_bl_log_c +
    ADAS_bl_c     + Time_year:ADAS_bl_c +
    LM_bl_c       + Time_year:LM_bl_c +
    Age_mri_bl_c + Sex_bl + Edu_bl + factor(APOE4_carrier) + Dx_bl +
    ICV_c +
    (1 + Time_year | ID_merged),
  data = mri_long %>% filter(!is.na(ECthick_z))
)
summary(m_EC)
```

```{r}
## ===== 必要包 =====
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(lubridate)
  library(stringr)
  library(lmerTest)
})

## ===== 仅一条时间轴（MRI 合并表）=====
adni_merged_mri <- ad_merge(
  path = "ADNI_demonstration",
  DATE_type = "Date",
  timeline_file = "UCSFFSX7",
  dict_src = ADNI_table
)

## ===== 用 review_complete：MRI + 协变量 + 认知 + CSF 都要齐（单次“基线行”）=====
check_cols <- c(
  # MRI
  "ST29SV","ST88SV","ST24TA","ST83TA","ST10CV",
  # 协变量
  "PTDOBYY","PTGENDER","PTEDUCAT","GENOTYPE","DIAGNOSIS",
  # 认知（同一行必须有）
  "TOTSCORE","LIMMTOTAL",
  # CSF（你指定）
  "AB42_F","pT217_F"
)

complete_ADNI_mri <- review_complete(adni_merged_mri, check_cols = check_cols)

## ===== 1) 单一“基线表”：每人第一条所有 check_cols 都齐的记录 =====
bl_all <- complete_ADNI_mri$complete_df %>%
  mutate(
    ID_merged     = as.character(ID_merged),
    Date_timeline = as.Date(Date_timeline)
  ) %>%
  filter(if_all(all_of(check_cols), ~ !is.na(.))) %>%
  arrange(ID_merged, Date_timeline) %>%
  group_by(ID_merged) %>%
  slice_head(n = 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  transmute(
    ID_merged,
    mri_bl_date = Date_timeline,

    ## MRI 基线派生（控制起点用）
    Hipp_bl   = (ST29SV + ST88SV)/2,
    EC_bl     = (ST24TA + ST83TA)/2,
    ICV_bl    = ST10CV,
    Hipp_bl_c = as.numeric(scale(Hipp_bl, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)),
    EC_bl_c   = as.numeric(scale(EC_bl,   center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)),
    ICV_bl_c  = as.numeric(scale(ICV_bl,  center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)),

    ## 认知基线（输入）
    ADAS_bl   = TOTSCORE,
    LM_bl     = LIMMTOTAL,
    ADAS_bl_c = as.numeric(scale(TOTSCORE,  center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)),
    LM_bl_c   = as.numeric(scale(LIMMTOTAL, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)),

    ## CSF 基线（输入）
    Abeta42_bl    = AB42_F,
    pTau_bl       = pT217_F,
    Abeta42_bl_c  = as.numeric(scale(Abeta42_bl, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)),
    pTau_bl_log_c = { x <- ifelse(pTau_bl > 0, log(pTau_bl), NA_real_)
                      as.numeric(scale(x, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)) },

    ## 协变量（基线）
    PTDOBYY_bl  = PTDOBYY,
    PTGENDER_bl = PTGENDER,
    PTEDUCAT_bl = PTEDUCAT,
    GENOTYPE_bl = GENOTYPE,
    DIAGNOSIS_bl= DIAGNOSIS,
    Age_mri_bl   = year(mri_bl_date) - PTDOBYY,
    Age_mri_bl_c = as.numeric(scale(Age_mri_bl, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)),
    Sex_bl = factor(case_when(PTGENDER == 1 ~ "M",
                              PTGENDER == 2 ~ "F",
                              TRUE ~ NA_character_), levels = c("M","F")),
    Dx_bl  = factor(case_when(DIAGNOSIS == 1 ~ "CN",
                              DIAGNOSIS == 2 ~ "MCI",
                              DIAGNOSIS == 3 ~ "AD",
                              TRUE ~ NA_character_), levels = c("CN","MCI","AD")),
    Edu_bl        = PTEDUCAT,
    APOE4_carrier = as.integer(str_detect(as.character(GENOTYPE), "4"))
  )

## ===== 2) MRI 纵向长表：基线广播 + 去负时间 + 同日去重 + ≥2 次 MRI =====
mri_long <- adni_merged_mri$analysis_data %>%
  mutate(
    ID_merged     = as.character(ID_merged),
    Date_timeline = as.Date(Date_timeline)
  ) %>%
  semi_join(bl_all %>% select(ID_merged), by = "ID_merged") %>%
  select(ID_merged, Date_timeline, ST29SV, ST88SV, ST24TA, ST83TA, ST10CV) %>%
  distinct(ID_merged, Date_timeline, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%        # 同日去重
  left_join(bl_all, by = "ID_merged") %>%
  filter(Date_timeline >= mri_bl_date) %>%                         # 基线及之后
  mutate(
    Time_year = as.numeric(difftime(Date_timeline, mri_bl_date, units = "days"))/365.25,
    Hipp      = (ST29SV + ST88SV)/2,
    ECthick   = (ST24TA + ST83TA)/2,
    ICV       = ST10CV,
    Hipp_z    = as.numeric(scale(Hipp,    center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)),
    ECthick_z = as.numeric(scale(ECthick, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE))
  ) %>%
  group_by(ID_merged) %>%
  filter(sum(!is.na(Hipp)) >= 2 | sum(!is.na(ECthick)) >= 2) %>%  # 至少两次 MRI
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(ID_merged, Time_year)

## ===== 3) 建模（MRI 为输出，CSF + 认知为输入；控制 MRI 起点与基线 ICV）=====

## 模型 A：海马体（Hipp_z）
m_Hipp <- lmer(
  Hipp_z ~ Time_year +
    Abeta42_bl_c  + Time_year:Abeta42_bl_c +
    pTau_bl_log_c + Time_year:pTau_bl_log_c +
    ADAS_bl_c     + Time_year:ADAS_bl_c +
    LM_bl_c       + Time_year:LM_bl_c +
    Hipp_bl_c +                          # 控制 MRI 起点（海马）
    Age_mri_bl_c + Sex_bl + Edu_bl + factor(APOE4_carrier) + Dx_bl +
    ICV_bl_c +                           # 用“基线”ICV 做体积校正
    (1 + Time_year | ID_merged),
  data = mri_long %>% filter(!is.na(Hipp_z))
)
summary(m_Hipp)

## 模型 B：内嗅皮层（ECthick_z）
m_EC <- lmer(
  ECthick_z ~ Time_year +
    Abeta42_bl_c  + Time_year:Abeta42_bl_c +
    pTau_bl_log_c + Time_year:pTau_bl_log_c +
    ADAS_bl_c     + Time_year:ADAS_bl_c +
    LM_bl_c       + Time_year:LM_bl_c +
    EC_bl_c +                            # 控制 MRI 起点（EC）
    Age_mri_bl_c + Sex_bl + Edu_bl + factor(APOE4_carrier) + Dx_bl +
    ICV_bl_c +
    (1 + Time_year | ID_merged),
  data = mri_long %>% filter(!is.na(ECthick_z))
)
summary(m_EC)

## =====（可选）总关联版本：不条件于 CSF（检验级联方向的敏感性分析）=====
m_Hipp_total <- lmer(
  Hipp_z ~ Time_year +
    ADAS_bl_c + Time_year:ADAS_bl_c +
    LM_bl_c   + Time_year:LM_bl_c   +
    Hipp_bl_c +
    Age_mri_bl_c + Sex_bl + Edu_bl + factor(APOE4_carrier) + Dx_bl +
    ICV_bl_c +
    (1 + Time_year | ID_merged),
  data = mri_long %>% filter(!is.na(Hipp_z))
)

summary(m_Hipp_total)

m_EC_total <- lmer(
  ECthick_z ~ Time_year +
    ADAS_bl_c + Time_year:ADAS_bl_c +
    LM_bl_c   + Time_year:LM_bl_c   +
    EC_bl_c +
    Age_mri_bl_c + Sex_bl + Edu_bl + factor(APOE4_carrier) + Dx_bl +
    ICV_bl_c +
    (1 + Time_year | ID_merged),
  data = mri_long %>% filter(!is.na(ECthick_z))
)

summary(m_EC_total)

# 查看两套结果差异（条件CSF vs 总关联）
anova(m_Hipp_total, m_Hipp)
anova(m_EC_total,   m_EC)
```
